SYNTHETIC FIXTURE - invented beamtime notes. No real note prose, sample
identity or scientific value appears anywhere in this file. It reproduces the
DOCX-table-flattened structure of the real notes: one line per table cell,
tab-prefixed, with an EMPTY cell flattening to a lone tab. This file is written
with a UTF-8 BOM and CRLF line endings, which is what the real one has.

Beam September 9-12, 2001
Tuesday (11:00 am) - Friday (6:00 am)

Main Scopes

Invented study of a synthetic oxide under two invented media. Nothing here
describes any real experiment.

What to have ready
-      1.0 M SynAcid solution
-      Electrochemical cell
-      Working electrode

Procedure for Preparing Electrode
-      Wipe the working electrode. Dry it.
-      Dropcast 4 uL of the invented ink. Wait until it dries.

Experimental Notes
In ALL experiments we used 1.0 M SynBase from the same solution prepared in the beginning of the beam time
